structured_output.what_is_happening: "Meme Acceleration" (m/acc) is a play on e/acc. Within about 15 minutes at least 10 same-name clones launched, and the packet's GeckoTerminal link points to a post by @PlanetOfMemes (roughly 316K followers), which is probably what set it off. This token is a Meteora pool, not pump.fun. Its creator seeded the pool (about $35k of liquidity against a $30k market cap), and 100% of the LP is unlocked. It has had about $300k of volume, 1,321 unique buyers against 94 sellers, and is up about 180% since launch. A pump.fun clone (HGLz…) has about the same h1 volume ($320k) at a $20k market cap, so this is an active ticker war.

narrative.description: m/acc ('meme accelerationism') riffs on e/acc accelerationism culture, apparently set off by a Planet Of Memes X post. An older m/acc token (FBaH…pump, from about Nov 2024) also exists.
narrative.why_spreading: It looks like a post from a large meme account prompted a rush of clone launches. The e/acc angle is a known theme, but the post itself couldn't be read (X returned 403).

token_connection.why_this_token: Of the clones it has the most liquidity and the most unique buyers ($35k liquidity, 1,321 buyers). GeckoTerminal links it to the PlanetOfMemes status. Nothing shows the source account endorsing it.
token_connection.competing_tokens: HGLz…pump has the same volume ($320k h1, $20k market cap). 8wES…pump has $98k h1 volume. There are 8+ more dead clones and an older FBaH…pump m/acc from 2024.

authenticity.evidence: Buyer breadth is high (1,321 unique buyers vs 94 sellers), with no paid boosts, no smart-money wallets and no KOL wallets. But GMGN flags 46 bundler wallets holding about 30% among top traders, and RugCheck finds a 38-wallet trade insider network.
authenticity.uncertainty: The source post could not be fetched, and I couldn't see X discussion of this contract.

structural_risks: 100% of the LP is unlocked in a creator-seeded Meteora pool, so the creator can pull liquidity at any time
46 bundler wallets, with bundlers about 30% among top traders
Creator status 'creator_close'; creator also has a prior token that reached a $1.1M ATH

structured_output.counterargument: It leads the clone war on liquidity and buyer count, which is exceptional breadth at a $30k market cap. Top-10 holders own only about 17%, and the dev holds nothing. If the Planet Of Memes post keeps spreading, a doubling from $30k is easy, and deep liquidity can make it the default choice among the clones.
unknowns: Content and reach of the PlanetOfMemes post
Whether the creator will pull the unlocked LP
Which clone the community settles on

source_coverage.notes: Contract search returned nothing. The X status gave 403. The name search only found e/acc background and an older 2024 m/acc token. There was no time for Reddit, Telegram or Discord.

structured_output.thesis: Buyer breadth is strong in a fast clone war, with plausible narrative potential, but the pool is a creator-seeded Meteora pool with fully unlocked LP, sizeable bundler and insider networks, and a same-volume pump.fun rival. The upside is real, but so is the rug risk.
